cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/mkbr2.c <<'C'
#include <brotli/encode.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <stdint.h>
int main(int argc,char**argv){size_t block=argc>1?strtoul(argv[1],0,0):75000; int reps=argc>2?atoi(argv[2]):4; size_t inlen=block*reps; unsigned char *in=malloc(inlen); uint32_t x=1; for(size_t i=0;i<block;i++){x=x*1103515245u+12345u; in[i]=(unsigned char)(x>>16);} for(int r=1;r<reps;r++) for(size_t i=0;i<block;i++) in[r*block+i]=in[i]; size_t max=BrotliEncoderMaxCompressedSize(inlen); unsigned char *out=malloc(max); size_t outlen=max; if(!BrotliEncoderCompress(11,22,BROTLI_MODE_GENERIC,inlen,in,&outlen,out)){return 1;} fprintf(stderr,"block=%zu reps=%d in=%zu out=%zu initial=%zu\n",block,reps,inlen,outlen,outlen*2); fwrite(out,1,outlen,stdout); return 0;}
C



cc /tmp/mkbr2.c -lbrotlienc -o /tmp/mkbr2


for b in 66000 70000 75000 80000 90000 100000; do /tmp/mkbr2 $b 4 > /tmp/r$b.br; /tmp/testbr /tmp/r$b.br 2>&1 | tail -5 | sed "s/^/b=$b /"; done
